def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    vehicle_patches = image_patch.find("vehicle")

    buses = [v for v in white_vehicles if v.verify_property("vehicle", "bus")]
    trucks = [v for v in white_vehicles if v.verify_property("vehicle", "truck")]
    vans = [v for v in white_vehicles if v.verify_property("vehicle", "van")]
    if len(buses) == 1 and len(trucks) == 1 and len(vans) == 2:
        return white_vehicles
    return []
